breakpoint.$description: Media-query breakpoints. The Figma UDS Design Kit has no breakpoint variables (it models Desktop/Mobile column widths instead); the legacy SCSS theme uses xl=1260px and xxxl=1920px — alignment pending Brand confirmation (UDS-2275). CSS custom properties cannot be used inside @media queries; consume these via the SCSS output or build tooling.

lg.$description: Large devices (desktops) — heading size mode switches here

xl.$description: Extra large devices. Legacy SCSS uses 1260px — pending Brand decision.

xxl.$description: Max container width. Not present in the legacy SCSS theme.
